"""One-off VC-01 collection and bounded historical-cost probe, outside the repo."""
import collections
import hashlib
import importlib.metadata
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import platform
import subprocess
import sys
import time

ROOT = Path('/workspace/scratch/4e5267fe5990/source-integrity-toolkit')
OUT = Path('/workspace/scratch/4e5267fe5990/vc01-evidence')
OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
MODE = sys.argv[1]
os.environ.update(SIT_PHASE_UNIT='P3-W15', PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE='1',
                  PYTEST_DISABLE_PLUGIN_AUTOLOAD='1', PIP_NO_INDEX='1')
sys.path[:0] = [str(ROOT), str(ROOT / 'src')]
os.chdir(ROOT)
counts = collections.Counter()
started = time.perf_counter()


def audit(event, args):
    if event != 'subprocess.Popen':
        return
    executable, argv, cwd, env = args
    program = Path(str(executable)).name
    if program in ('git', 'git.exe'):
        counts['git:' + str(argv[1] if len(argv) > 1 else '<empty>')] += 1
    elif program.startswith('python'):
        counts['child_python'] += 1
    else:
        counts['other_child'] += 1


sys.addaudithook(audit)
import pytest


class Capture:
    def __init__(self):
        self.items = []
        self.reports = []

    def pytest_collection_finish(self, session):
        for item in session.items:
            obj = item.obj
            code = getattr(obj, '__code__', None)
            self.items.append({'nodeid': item.nodeid,
                               'qualname': getattr(obj, '__qualname__', None),
                               'function_name': getattr(obj, '__name__', None),
                               'code_line': code.co_firstlineno if code else None,
                               'code_path': code.co_filename if code else None})

    def pytest_runtest_logreport(self, report):
        self.reports.append({'nodeid': report.nodeid, 'when': report.when,
                             'outcome': report.outcome, 'seconds': report.duration})


selected = [
    'tests/contract/test_phase2_transition.py::W07R01Tests::test_prior_phase2_transition_tests_keep_every_statement',
    'tests/contract/test_phase2_transition.py::W08R01Tests::test_literal_permission_deltas_preserve_every_other_byte',
    'tests/contract/test_phase2_transition.py::W09R01Tests::test_literal_deltas_validate_every_live_predecessor_byte',
    'tests/contract/test_phase3_transition.py::test_current_migration_sources_match_reviewed_bytes_and_remain_live',
    'tests/contract/test_phase3_transition.py::test_w04_r01_two_live_methods_preserve_all_original_assertions_and_bindings',
    'tests/contract/test_phase3_transition.py::test_w05_r01_only_three_old_transition_methods_have_authorized_adaptations',
    'tests/contract/test_phase3_transition.py::test_w06_r01_only_seven_old_transition_methods_change_and_every_other_source_node_is_exact',
    'tests/contract/test_phase3_transition.py::test_w06_r01_actual_boundary_remains_original_six_paths_and_complete_accepted_history',
    'tests/contract/test_phase3_transition.py::test_w15_r02_source_deltas_preserve_every_prior_node_and_identity',
    'tests/contract/test_phase3_transition.py::test_w15_r03_source_deltas_preserve_existing_nodes_and_bound_only_ci_budgets',
]
capture = Capture()
before = {p: hashlib.sha256((ROOT / p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
          for p in subprocess.check_output(['git', 'ls-files'], text=True).splitlines()}
counts.clear()
if MODE == 'collect':
    args = ['tests', '--collect-only', '-q', '-p', 'no:cacheprovider']
elif MODE == 'measure':
    args = [*selected, '-q', '-p', 'no:cacheprovider',
            '--basetemp', str(OUT / 'pytest'), '--junitxml', str(OUT / 'measure-junit.xml')]
else:
    raise ValueError(MODE)
probe_start = time.perf_counter()
status = pytest.main(args, plugins=[capture])
elapsed = time.perf_counter() - probe_start
probe_counts = dict(sorted(counts.items()))
after = {p: hashlib.sha256((ROOT / p).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in before}
result = {'mode': MODE, 'exit_code': int(status), 'elapsed_seconds': elapsed,
          'platform': platform.platform(), 'python': sys.version,
          'tools': {p: importlib.metadata.version(p) for p in
                    ('pytest', 'setuptools', 'iniconfig', 'packaging', 'pluggy', 'Pygments')},
          'head': subprocess.check_output(['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], text=True).strip(),
          'tree': subprocess.check_output(['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD^{tree}'], text=True).strip(),
          'unit': 'P3-W15', 'purpose': 'unchanged accepted baseline only; not VC authorization',
          'measurement_scope': 'direct child launches observed in the pytest process; excludes descendants',
          'subprocess_counts': probe_counts, 'items': capture.items, 'reports': capture.reports,
          'selected': selected if MODE == 'measure' else 'all tests',
          'tracked_before': before, 'tracked_after_unchanged': before == after,
          'new_ci_run': False, 'release_certification': False}
(OUT / (MODE + '.json')).write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2) + '\n')
print('VC01_PROBE', json.dumps({k:v for k,v in result.items() if k not in ('items','reports','tracked_before','selected')}))
raise SystemExit(status)

"""One-time VC-03 equivalence/collection audit, never a repository runtime oracle."""
import ast
import collections
import copy
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys
import time

BASE = Path('/workspace/scratch/4e5267fe5990')
ROOT = BASE / 'source-integrity-toolkit'
ANCHOR = '2413a29b839b7e1de8f76a449762f031de19d52b'
INTAKE = 'eb730dda31d189c8487b5247a45bae47b678821b'
sys.path[:0] = [str(ROOT), str(ROOT / 'src')]
os.chdir(ROOT)
os.environ.update(PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE='1', PYTEST_DISABLE_PLUGIN_AUTOLOAD='1')
os.environ.pop('SIT_PHASE_UNIT', None)
from tools import check_scaffold_boundary as guard


def git(*args):
    return subprocess.check_output(['git', *args], cwd=ROOT)


def source(commit, path):
    return git('show', commit + ':' + path).decode()


def function(text, qualname):
    node = ast.parse(text)
    for name in qualname.split('.'):
        node = next(n for n in node.body if isinstance(n, (ast.FunctionDef, ast.ClassDef)) and n.name == name)
    return node


def segment(text, node):
    return ast.get_source_segment(text, node)


def adapted(text):
    for before, after in (
        ('phase_guard.promotions(ROOT)', 'phase_guard.VC_ACTIVE'),
        ('guard.promotions(ROOT)', 'guard.VC_ACTIVE'),
        ('phase_guard.live_issues(', 'phase_guard.current_live_issues('),
        ('guard.check_repository(', 'guard.current_check_repository('),
        ('guard.layer_issues(', 'guard.current_layer_issues('),
        ('guard.import_cycle_issues(', 'guard.phase3_import_cycle_issues('),
        ('"--root", str(self.root)]', '"--root", str(self.root), "--modules-only"]'),
    ):
        text = text.replace(before, after)
    return text


mapping = json.loads((ROOT / 'verification/consolidation_map.json').read_bytes())
wrapper_rows = [r for r in mapping['mapping'] if r['old_test_function'].startswith('tests/scaffold/')]
proof = []
for row in wrapper_rows:
    old = row['old_source']; path = old['path']
    old_text = source(old['commit'], path)
    new_text = (ROOT / path).read_text()
    before = function(old_text, old['function'])
    identity = row['old_nodes'][0].split('[', 1)[0]
    qualname = '.'.join(identity.split('::')[1:])
    after = function(new_text, qualname)
    normalized = ast.parse(adapted(segment(old_text, before))).body[0]
    normalized.name = after.name
    adjustments = ['direct current API names, where present']
    if before.name == '_current_imports':
        normalized.body = [n for n in normalized.body if not (
            isinstance(n, ast.Assign) and ast.unparse(n.targets[0]) == 'active')]
        for node in ast.walk(normalized):
            if isinstance(node, ast.Call) and isinstance(node.func, ast.Attribute) and node.func.attr == 'current_layer_issues':
                node.keywords = [k for k in node.keywords if k.arg != 'live']
        adjustments.append('current dependency API uses the fixed accepted active set')
    if before.name == '_schema_reservation':
        assert isinstance(normalized.body[0], ast.Assign) and ast.unparse(normalized.body[0].targets[0]) == 'unit'
        assert isinstance(normalized.body[1], ast.If) and ast.unparse(normalized.body[1].test) == "unit.startswith('P3-')"
        normalized.body[:2] = ast.parse('bundle_delivered = True').body
        adjustments.append('accepted bundle-delivered state fixed; report schema stays reserved')
    # get_source_segment excludes decorators; test_each_planned_module_imports has one.
    normalized.decorator_list = copy.deepcopy(before.decorator_list)
    equal = ast.dump(normalized) == ast.dump(after)
    proof.append({'old_function': row['old_test_function'], 'current_function': path + '::' + qualname.replace('.', '::'),
                  'nodes': row['old_nodes'], 'source': old['commit'], 'ast_equal_after_explicit_context_adaptation': equal,
                  'context_adaptations': adjustments, 'old_assertion_sites': old['direct_assertion_sites'],
                  'new_source_sha256': hashlib.sha256(segment(new_text, after).encode()).hexdigest()})
assert all(r['ast_equal_after_explicit_context_adaptation'] for r in proof), [r['old_function'] for r in proof if not r['ast_equal_after_explicit_context_adaptation']]

prep_path = 'tests/security/test_preparation_inertness.py'
prep_name = 'test_whole_package_guard_rejects_forbidden_implementation_in_temporary_copy'
before = segment(source(ANCHOR, prep_path), function(source(ANCHOR, prep_path), prep_name))
after = segment((ROOT / prep_path).read_text(), function((ROOT / prep_path).read_text(), prep_name))
assert before.replace('unit = f"P3-W{guard.phase3_unit_number():02}"', 'unit = "VC"').replace(
    'guard.phase3_promotions(ROOT, unit=unit)', 'guard.promotions(ROOT, unit=unit)') == after

installed_path = 'tests/contract/test_phase2_transition.py'
installed_name = 'W08R01Tests.test_clean_installed_components_need_no_phase_policy_or_developer_tools'
before = segment(source(ANCHOR, installed_path), function(source(ANCHOR, installed_path), installed_name))
after = segment((ROOT / installed_path).read_text(), function((ROOT / installed_path).read_text(), installed_name))
assert before.replace('"unit": f"P3-W{guard.phase3_unit_number():02}"', '"unit": "VC"') == after

mixed = {}
for path, allowed in guard.VC_MIXED_FUNCTIONS.items():
    mixed[path] = guard._current_retained_parts(path, source(ANCHOR, path).encode()) == guard._current_retained_parts(path, (ROOT / path).read_bytes())
assert all(mixed.values()), mixed
accepted_modules = {line.split()[3].removeprefix('src/source_integrity_toolkit/'): line.split()[2]
                    for line in git('ls-tree', '-r', ANCHOR, '--', 'src').decode().splitlines()}
assert len(guard.VC_FROZEN_MODULES) == 24
assert all(accepted_modules[p] == oid for p, oid in guard.VC_FROZEN_MODULES.items())
assert all(guard.git_blob((ROOT / 'src/source_integrity_toolkit' / p).read_bytes()) == oid for p, oid in accepted_modules.items())
executable_source_calls = []
for path in [*ROOT.glob('tests/**/*.py'), ROOT / 'tools/check_scaffold_boundary.py']:
    for node in ast.walk(ast.parse(path.read_bytes())):
        if isinstance(node, ast.Call) and isinstance(node.func, ast.Name) and node.func.id in ('exec', 'compile'):
            executable_source_calls.append([str(path.relative_to(ROOT)), node.lineno, node.func.id])
assert executable_source_calls == []

audit = {'wrapper_functions': proof, 'functions_proved': len(proof), 'wrapper_identities_preserved': sum(len(r['nodes']) for r in proof),
         'preparation_fixture_exact_except_two_context_substitutions': True,
         'installed_witness_exact_except_evidence_unit_label': True, 'mixed_non_enumerated_source_exact': mixed,
         'accepted_48_product_bytes_unchanged': True, 'accepted_24_package_pins_match': True,
         'direct_exec_or_compile_calls_in_tests_and_guard': executable_source_calls,
         'probe_is_one_time_outside_repository': True}
(BASE / 'vc03-equivalence.json').write_text(json.dumps(audit, indent=2) + '\n')

counts = collections.Counter()
def audit_hook(event, args):
    if event == 'subprocess.Popen':
        counts[Path(str(args[0])).name + ':' + str(args[1][1] if len(args[1]) > 1 else '')] += 1
sys.addaudithook(audit_hook)
import pytest
class Capture:
    def pytest_collection_finish(self, session):
        self.items = [{'nodeid': i.nodeid, 'qualname': i.obj.__qualname__,
                       'code_path': i.obj.__code__.co_filename, 'code_line': i.obj.__code__.co_firstlineno} for i in session.items]
capture = Capture()
started = time.perf_counter()
status = pytest.main(['tests', '--collect-only', '-q', '-p', 'no:cacheprovider'], plugins=[capture])
elapsed = time.perf_counter() - started
assert status == 0
nodes = sorted(i['nodeid'] for i in capture.items)
old_nodes = set(json.loads((BASE / 'vc02-collection.json').read_bytes())['nodes'])
removed = sorted(old_nodes - set(nodes)); added = sorted(set(nodes) - old_nodes)
assert len(removed) == 2 and len(added) == 5
assert removed == ['tests/contract/test_phase2_transition.py::Phase2TransitionTests::test_altered_historical_test_bytes_cannot_execute',
                   'tests/contract/test_phase2_transition.py::Phase2TransitionTests::test_unlisted_historical_source_cannot_execute']
assert len(nodes) == len(set(nodes)) == 4087 and counts == {}
assert {n for r in proof for n in r['nodes']} <= set(nodes)
collection = {'count': len(nodes), 'files': len({n.split('::')[0] for n in nodes}), 'nodes': nodes,
              'items': capture.items, 'added_since_vc02': added, 'removed_since_vc02': removed,
              'sorted_nodes_sha256': hashlib.sha256(('\n'.join(nodes) + '\n').encode()).hexdigest(),
              'elapsed_seconds': elapsed, 'direct_subprocess_calls': dict(counts), 'phase_unit_environment': None}
(BASE / 'vc03-collection.json').write_text(json.dumps(collection, indent=2) + '\n')
print('VC03_AUDIT', json.dumps({k:v for k,v in collection.items() if k not in ('nodes','items')}))

assert len(nodes)==len(now) and old<=now
added=sorted(now-old);assert len(added)==29 and len(now)==3724

files={p.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix() for scope in c['scopes'] for p in (ROOT/scope).rglob('test_*.py')}
g.current_collection(nodes,files)
wrappers={'tests/scaffold/'+p+'.py' for p in ('test_imports','test_module_manifest','test_no_runtime_implementation','test_layer_boundaries','test_contract_catalogs','test_ci_contract')}
original_wrappers={n for r in m['mapping'] for n in r['old_nodes'] if n.split('::',1)[0] in wrappers}

assert hashlib.sha256((ROOT/g.VC_PLAN).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==g.VC_PLAN_SHA256
product=sorted((ROOT/'src').rglob('*.py'));assert len(product)==48
for p in product:
 assert p.read_bytes()==subprocess.check_output(['git','show',g.VC_ACCEPTED_HEAD+':'+p.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix()],cwd=ROOT)

assert set(changed)<=g.VC_PATHS
report={'parent':head,'count':len(nodes),'files':len(files),'directory_counts':dict(sorted(Counter(n.split('/')[1] for n in nodes).items())),
 'sorted_nodes_sha256':hashlib.sha256(('\n'.join(sorted(nodes))+'\n').encode()).hexdigest(),

from pathlib import Path
import datetime,hashlib,json,os,subprocess,time
BASE=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
ROOT=BASE/'source-integrity-toolkit'
PYTHON=BASE/'vc01-venv/bin/python'
def sources():
 names=subprocess.check_output(['git','ls-files','-z'],cwd=ROOT).decode().strip('\0').split('\0')
 return {p:hashlib.sha256((ROOT/p).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in names}
before=sources(); started=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(); clock=time.monotonic()
(BASE/'vc05-local-start.json').write_text(json.dumps({'start_utc':started,'source_hashes':before},indent=2)+'\n')
cmd=[str(PYTHON),'-B','tests/scaffold/test_ci_contract.py','--local','--evidence-dir',str(BASE/'vc05-local-full')]
env=dict(os.environ);env.update(PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE='1',PYTEST_DISABLE_PLUGIN_AUTOLOAD='1')
with (BASE/'vc05-local-entry.log').open('wb') as output:
 result=subprocess.run(cmd,cwd=ROOT,env=env,stdout=output,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,timeout=2600)
after=sources()
record={'command':cmd,'start_utc':started,'end_utc':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
 'elapsed_seconds':time.monotonic()-clock,'exit_code':result.returncode,
 'head':subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],cwd=ROOT,text=True).strip(),
 'source_hashes_before':before,'source_hashes_after':after,'tracked_files_unchanged':before==after,
 'scope':'Actual canonical local entry, all five directories; not hosted matrix'}
(BASE/'vc05-local-run.json').write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({k:v for k,v in record.items() if not k.startswith('source_hashes')},indent=2),flush=True)
raise SystemExit(result.returncode)
